# Novelio Technologies LLC
> Novelio Technologies LLC is a US-based digital marketing agency and business growth partner for small businesses. Founded in 2014, the company provides website design, SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, lead generation, marketing automation, branding, email marketing, and tech operations services. Novelio serves owner-operated businesses across all 50 US states.

## Partner Program
Novelio Technologies partners with agencies, freelancers, consultants, SaaS/technology companies, and IT firms through referral, white-label/reseller, technology/integration, and agency/strategic partnerships. Partners can refer clients for recurring commissions or resell Novelio's website, mobile app, SEO, and marketing services under their own brand. Free to join, no setup or monthly fees. Apply at https://www.noveliotech.com/partners
